facts.fact: The ODPC is headed by Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait, who has served six years, and President Ruto nominated Lydia Sitienei Chelagat to succeed her on 10 November 2026.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)

facts.fact: The ODPC investigated the Business Registration Service breach on its own initiative, issued BRS an enforcement notice to strengthen its systems and closed the matter without a penalty notice once BRS complied, per the outgoing Commissioner.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC)

facts.fact: The ODPC ordered St Luke Orthopaedic & Trauma Hospital in Eldoret to pay a patient KSh525,000 for mishandling and disclosing medical information.
